annotations.title: FAA delays at Puerto Rico airports

description: The FAA's national airspace status for Puerto Rico's airports (San Juan SJU, Aguadilla BQN, Ponce PSE) and the mainland gateways with the most San Juan flights (Orlando, Fort Lauderdale, Miami, New York JFK, Newark, Philadelphia, Atlanta): ground stops, ground delay programs, general arrival and departure delays and closures, with reader lines like 'SJU: no FAA delay programs as of 6:10 PM AST'. IMPORTANT: an airport with no FAA program is NOT 'on time' — airline delays (a late inbound plane, a crew) are never in this feed; for a flight's own status point to the airline or the flight board URL returned. `lines` is null when the FAA was not read in the last half hour. Cite 787daily.com/live/.
